refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to retrieve the real-number value of a token

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoTokenGetReal function gets the real-number value of object.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoTokenGetReal returns the real-number value of object if object holds a real-number value. If object does not hold a real-number token, then SilikoTokenGetReal returns a NaN (not a number) value.
